definitions.explanation: The international youth organization for boys focused on outdoor activities, citizenship, and character development. Also refers to an individual member of the organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ボーイスカウト⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: My son is in the Boy Scouts.

examples.japanese: ボーイスカウト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: We go camping as part of Boy Scout activities.

examples.japanese: ボーイスカウト⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧、⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いろいろなこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。

notes:
ボーイスカウト is a loanword from English "Boy Scout(s)," referring both to the organization and to individual members. It denotes the same international scouting movement as in English-speaking countries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ボーイスカウト⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to join the Boy Scouts
- ボーイスカウト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: Boy Scout activities
- ボーイスカウト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧: Boy Scout uniform
- ボーイスカウト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隊長|たいちょう}: Boy Scout leader

RELATED WORDS:
- ガール⟦スカウト→スカウト：11696_sukauto⟧: Girl Scouts
- カブ⟦スカウト→スカウト：11696_sukauto⟧: Cub Scouts (younger boys)
- ⟦ベンチャー→ベンチャー：06408_benchaa⟧⟦スカウト→スカウト：11696_sukauto⟧: Venture Scouts (older youth program)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, scouting is organized under {ボーイスカウト日本連盟|ぼーいすかうとにほんれんめい} (Scout Association of Japan). Scouts wear standard scouting uniforms with neckerchiefs and earn merit badges. Membership is significantly smaller than in some Western countries but remains a recognizable youth activity, especially in suburban communities.
